get_thread_description.caveat: GetThreadDescription returns nonzero for every attempted thread; no TX/RX name attribution, not evidence threads are Go.

scope: Measured one Windows EXE process including original Go runtime, Rust DLL, its syscall charge, startup and Stop; does not include separate Python generators, Linux peer, system driver ISR/DPC, per-function AES or Wintun/NPF CPU.

outbound: Wintun receive one copy into reusable source slab
8 original IPv4 frames sealed under one Entry lock
build IPv4 TCP Ethernet into independent frame buffer
Npcap queue copies Ethernet frames then kernel transmit
second Entry lock settles M2 actual accepted/unconfirmed prefix
inbound: Npcap pcap_next_ex per frame and copies caplen
Rust Entry lock for AEAD open and replay PN
Wintun AllocateSendPacket + copy + SendPacket per IPv4
already_improved: TX batch eight records two locks
M2 timer earliest deadline not 20ms poll
direct TCP-looking ACK build into target frame
candidate_not_proven_hot: Wintun allocate/copy/send and Wintun loan copies
M2 lock latency and AEAD under owner lock

recommendation: First determine TX/RX exact OS TID via one-shot Rust GetCurrentThreadId startup identity; GetThreadDescription failed 0x10000000 in all 1241 attempted thread accesses. Then diagnostic feature-gated lower-rate CPU-cycle or ETW stack sampling for NPF/Wintun/AEAD/wake; do not optimize protocol, AEAD/PN or lock without stage evidence. Maintain 150Mbps/0%-netem/60s/99.9%-first-delivery/Stop gate.
